preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string s must have a length between 1 and 100.
All characters in each test case string s must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(s == s[:len(s)//2] * 2 for s in test_cases) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the string is square, otherwise output 'NO'.
